title: Audit History Page Tables
description: The audit and history pages should be proper tables, and not use the show/hide icon. They need to be filterable/sortable, etc. like a highend spreadsheet. Screenshot reference: Screenshot 2026-05-25 131330.png (local account path omitted from repo task content; attach or copy a sanitized asset before PR).

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Upgraded the Admin audit and history tabs into pageable spreadsheet-style tables with explicit search/filter/sort controls, visible size and sequence columns, and copy-only target/artifact cells. Removed the reveal/hide affordance from these tabs while preserving quick copy actions. Validated with a focused admin markup test plus sandboxed browser sweeps against a disposable local admin instance, including a generated history row.
